title: Amos Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Amos 2: the words against Moab, Judah and Israel, the Amorite and the Nazirites.

questions.text: What is Moab charged with in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Moab is charged with burning the bones of the king of Edom into lime.

answers.text: Burning the bones of the king of Edom
Selling the poor for a pair of sandals

questions.text: Whose palaces will the fire sent on Moab devour?
questions.explanation: God says he will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth.

questions.text: Whom will God cut off from among them, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: He will cut off the judge from among them and kill all its princes with him.

questions.text: What is Judah charged with in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Judah has rejected Yahweh's law and has not kept his statutes, and their lies have led them astray.

questions.text: For what did Israel sell the needy, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Israel has sold the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals.

questions.text: What does verse 7 say they do to the oppressed?
questions.explanation: They trample on the dust of the earth on the head of the poor and deny justice to the oppressed.

answers.text: They drive them out of the land
They take their children as slaves

questions.text: What do they drink in the house of their God, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: They lay themselves down beside every altar on clothes taken in pledge, and in the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.

answers.text: The new wine of the harvest
The wine of those who have been fined

questions.text: To what is the Amorite's height compared in verse 9?
questions.explanation: God destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and who was strong as the oaks.

questions.text: What did God raise up some of their young men to be, according to verse 11?
questions.explanation: He raised up some of their sons for prophets and some of their young men for Nazirites.

questions.text: What does verse 16 say the courageous among the mighty will do on that day?
questions.explanation: He who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day.
